cover_letter.greeting: Dear AMXL Middle Mile & 3P Carrier Strategy Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role on the AMXL Middle Mile & 3P Carrier Strategy Finance team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What draws me to this team is how close it sits to operations: the job is to find cost and efficiency ideas in a growing transportation network and get the business to act on them.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and running variance and sensitivity analysis on budget reallocation. Before that, at Thomson Reuters, I worked in order management, handled cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows, and helped automate parts of the order-to-cash process, which cut the cash conversion cycle by 20%.

That maps to the cost optimization and efficiency work you describe, and to partnering with operations teams who need clear numbers to make decisions. I use Tableau and Excel daily and I'm comfortable learning new data tools quickly. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
